title: A Viola, circa 1700, L.O.B. 16⁹/16in. (422mm), in a shaped case. The two-piece back of slab figure, the ribs of similar figure, the scroll later, English of the 19th-century, the table of two pieces, broad to open grain on the right, narrow to medium grain on the left, the varnish of a red-brown colour on a yellow ground. This instrument is composite, the back and front have been reshaped with re-edging and half-edging, the corners of the upper table have been reshaped. As seen.
